goal: Stop conflating system runtime failures with block invalidity across validation and block storage
Prevent non-validating routines from taking validation state parameters solely for error signaling
Pave the way for validation routines to return validation states directly instead of boolean flags
agreement: Reviewers are divided on error-handling design between explicit return values and exceptions
Objection that expected return types slow IBD and risk chain splits if callers conflate errors (purpleKarrot)
Objection that introducing a new kernel fatal error type expands the kernel maintenance surface (arejula27)
Objection that flattening returns into booleans leaves safety reliant on reviewer vigilance (alexanderwiederin)
Concept support for separating runtime errors via return values instead of exceptions (optout21, hodlinator, l0rinc)
